start: Member finishes a workout: bench press 60 kg x 10 x 3, one warm-up set, pull-ups

steps.action: Open History, Profile's history chart and Charts
user_sees: The same kg lifted for that workout on every screen
must_not: Two screens with different kg for the same workout

start: Workouts with pull-ups, dumbbells counted 'each', and a plank

user_sees: Pull-ups count that day's body weight; 'each' dumbbells count both hands; plank and runs count 0 kg
must_not: Pull-ups counted as 0 kg when a body weight exists

start: Member with pull-ups logged and no body weight ever entered

user_sees: Kg lifted without the body weight part, with a note that body weight is missing (exact words not read)

start: Member changes how an exercise is counted (total to each), then edits and deletes sets

user_sees: Sets logged before keep their own counting; new ones use the new one
must_not: Every old workout's kg changed at once

steps.action: Edit a set's weight, then delete a workout
user_sees: Every screen shows the new totals after the change
must_not: An old total kept by a cached read

start: Kg lifted on screens and anything shared

steps.action: Look at what leaves the phone (share picture, gym leaderboard)
user_sees: Kg lifted only as a total
must_not: A shared figure from which body weight can be worked out (for example kg lifted divided by pull-up reps)
